Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler rejected my request with a credentials error: the Gateway needs its auth token or device pairing configured before it accepts new automations. Nothing is scheduled yet, so no digest will post on Monday 19 October unless that's fixed. I haven't posted anything either.

Once the scheduler is reachable, the plan is a Monday 08:00 Chicago post here in #coastal-team, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random from the previous week, plus open customer items. It will leave out money terms and finance documents, since this channel is wider than the finance-approved group. If you'd like, I can post the digest by hand each Monday until the schedule is working. The Gateway operator needs to fix the scheduler credentials before I can create the recurring job.
